integrity: The exact powered radius theorem was checked in its verbatim reproduction in the 2026 primary preprint, whose improved theorem specializes the same equation to N=1. The 2021 endpoint paper was inspected at the full theorem text for p=1 and p=2. Monotonicity, convergence, and the exponential prefactor were reconstructed directly from the root equation by differentiation and the mean value theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem quantifies the asymptotic behavior of an implicitly defined sharp radius and does not strengthen the underlying Bohr--Rogosinski inequality. No uniform remainder estimate in p, N, and m is claimed. The full 2025 publisher text was not available in the lawful full-text route used for this check, so an unindexed same-rate remark there remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exponential high-order stabilization of powered Bohr–Rogosinski radii
